[SWS_CM_00073] Reception of Time-Synchronous Control Format messages
⌈
If
an
IEEE1722 ACF stream
message
is
received
and
the
attribute
IEEE1722TpAcfConnection.acfMaxTransitTime is defined, then the IEEE1722
ACF stream message presentation time shall be checked:
• if
the
current
time
of
the
GlobalTimeDomain
referenced
by
IEEE1722TpConnection.globalTimeDomain
is
greater
than
the
pre-
sentation time of the received IEEE1722 ACF stream message (the message
was received too late), then the IEEE1722 ACF stream message shall be
dropped.
• if
the
current
time
of
the
GlobalTimeDomain
referenced
by
IEEE1722TpConnection.globalTimeDomain
is
smaller
or
equal
than
the presentation time of the received IEEE1722 ACF stream message, than
the IEEE1722 ACF stream message shall be buffered until the presentation
time is reached.
⌋
